_metadata.name: realism-text-to-img
_metadata.description: Photorealistic text-to-image — SDXL (Juggernaut-XL v9 RunDiffusionPhoto) + the 'Realism by Stable Yogi' LoRA on the UNet @ 1.0. Unlike the old FLUX build, the LoRA is an SDXL LoRA so on this SDXL base it ACTUALLY loads and contributes. Select it when the user references 'realism-text-to-img' or asks for a realistic / photoreal portrait or scene. Default 1024x1024 (SDXL native). SDXL works best near 1024 — use the aspect buckets, NOT the FLUX 2K recipes: portrait 832x1216, landscape 1216x832, wide-ish 1344x768. Going much above ~1.3MP causes SDXL duplication/anatomy artifacts. LoRA strength baked at 1.0 (edit the JSON to tune); trained for Pony but applies on any SDXL UNet.

defaults.negative: cartoon, anime, illustration, painting, drawing, 3d render, cgi, blurry, low quality, lowres, deformed, distorted, disfigured, bad anatomy, bad proportions, extra limbs, extra fingers, missing fingers, mutated hands, fused fingers, watermark, signature, text, jpeg artifacts, oversaturated, plastic skin, out of frame, cropped
